status: Prospective design, no cost binary built or native timing performed
purpose: Disclose the cost of the scoped import-completion extension, with protected already-completed imports and typed errors. No speedup from faster errors or new success versus old failure.
timing: First import in a fresh process, then seven batches of newly imported graphs. Only decode/admission and preallocated result-vector writes are timed. Every result is verified afterward through strict sign, checked reciprocal identity and orientation; exact wire equality is checked. Output materialization is retained until verification/drop outside timing. The first verification may warm shared constants before warm batches. Value parsing is outside timing for the Value API.
statistics: 30 balanced randomized paired processes per protected case/path; paired log Student t marginal95% and Bonferroni simultaneous95% over90 metrics (first import; warm median/max of7batches). All upper bounds must be <=1 for performance-only acceptance. Pilot5, final30 fixed before pilot; no sample-based tuning.
calibration: Baseline-only batches to at least2ms import time, max4096 results/batch; fixed before candidate comparisons.
allocations: Five separate paired campaigns with counting System allocator, 8 warm imports/batch; requested bytes/calls, retained-live delta and peak growth. Native timing uses uninstrumented System.
completion_cost: New success rows may be measured for absolute resource disclosure only; exclude baseline-error/candidate-success ratios.
containment: Per process120s/8GiB address space/64MiB output; pin one allowed CPU; keep all task-owned validation/builds outside native timing. Shared host is not claimed exclusive.
source_contract: Same harness/dependency lock/features/toolchain in both variants; only representation.rs changes at runtime. New cfg(test) sources are common to both builds. Preserve existing failed attempts and all unfavorable results.
